en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a statue of an armored medieval knight with a beard, holding a long spear and resting one hand on a book or shield. The statue stands on a tall stone pedestal inscribed in German Gothic script and bearing a heraldic shield. The monument is enclosed by short stone posts linked with chains, on a patterned pavement. In the background are leafy trees and plain facades of older European-style buildings.
